title: lycopus virginicus var. sherardii
intro: Lycopus virginicus var. sherardii, commonly known as Wood Betony, is a medicinal plant native to North America and Europe, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been used for centuries to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Wood Betony include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and carminative, making it useful for relieving symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome, menstrual cramps, and other gastrointestinal issues. Wood Betony's bioactive constituents include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
